name: Large Handcrafted Clay Milk Tea Jar
marketing_tip: Specifically designed for the rich textures of boiled milk tea and roasted infusions.
body: This robust clay jar features a side handle and a wooden lid, making it ideal for simmering thick milk teas. Its high heat capacity ensures that your brew stays warm, allowing the flavors to develop fully and deeply.
